gates.name: snapshot_and_base
gates.cmd: test $(sha256sum AGENTS.md | awk '{print $1}') = 88007b897ac6ee6aa85fe7ba5f61ed266e3753c04c237a8e5375807523d9aac9 && test $(sha256sum src/agents/AGENTS.md | awk '{print $1}') = 84d39b5e425557cb57d75e2664e1b95b0f3328804521c45b13a9ac54704c555d && test $(sha256sum src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/AGENTS.md | awk '{print $1}') = 53b697a64d47709f0f3a52db0ad0c3a07c054cab1d40083159028591bcc87042 && test $(git branch --show-current) = fix/settled-post-tool-finalization-unavailable && test $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main) = 194b7f2a16196481a70c139fb31f1777bdfbdc12
gates.must: exit 0; any mismatch pauses the loop before edits

gates.name: strict_red_then_green_boundary
gates.must: Coder records a pre-production-edit RED caused by the missing fallback; final run exits 0 with finalizeSettledTurn truly undefined

gates.name: fallback_behavior_contract
gates.must: exit 0; exactly one delivered and persisted fallback, no runAttempt replay, unchanged original attempt, honest failed-tool metadata, and preserved silentExpected behavior

gates.name: harness_sibling_contracts
gates.must: exit 0; built-in, selection, projection, Codex, and Copilot sibling contracts remain intact

gates.name: changed_and_static_gates
gates.cmd: pnpm changed:lanes && pnpm check:changed && pnpm check && pnpm check:test-types && pnpm build
gates.must: exit 0 on the exact candidate HEAD with no source or test edits during execution

gates.name: broad_test_gate
gates.must: exit 0; at most one policy-allowed rerun for a documented full-suite flake

gates.name: documentation_gate
gates.must: exit 0; settled-finalization documentation matches the deterministic host fallback and optional-callback behavior

gates.name: scope_and_loc_hygiene
gates.cmd: git diff --check 194b7f2a16196481a70c139fb31f1777bdfbdc12...HEAD && git diff --name-status 194b7f2a16196481a70c139fb31f1777bdfbdc12...HEAD && git diff --numstat 194b7f2a16196481a70c139fb31f1777bdfbdc12...HEAD
gates.must: no whitespace errors or out-of-scope files; production additions minus deletions are at most zero, with tests, docs, and planner artifacts classified separately

gates.name: exact_head_read_only_review
gates.must: Reviewer records this exact SHA after pre-review gates are green and returns no unresolved P0/P1, incomplete evidence, or Repair Doctrine finding
